summary: Middle East conflict (US-Iran war) is the primary geopolitical risk, spiking oil prices toward $110. US-China tech export controls widening to semiconductors/mature nodes. Tariff uncertainty and NATO/Greenland posture also factor. Investors rotating toward critical minerals, biotech, semiconductors as great-power competition intensifies.
